lines.beaver_en: Did you go to the zoo last weekend?
lines.learner: 네, 갔어요. 사자가 바위 위에 누워 있었어요.
lines.en: Yes, I did. A lion was lying on a rock.
lines.roman: Ne, gasseoyo. Sajaga bawi wie nuwo isseosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, a lion? Did you see other animals?
lines.learner: 곰도 봤어요. 곰이 물고기를 잡아먹고 있었어요.
lines.en: I saw a bear too. It was eating a fish.
lines.roman: Gomdo bwasseoyo. Gomi mulgogireul jabameokgo isseosseoyo.

lines.learner: 네, 원숭이가 꼬리로 나무에 매달려 있었어요.
lines.en: Yes, a monkey was hanging from a tree by its tail.
lines.roman: Ne, wonsungiga kkoriro namue maedallyeo isseosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: That sounds fun. Kids must have loved it.
lines.en: Yes, the kids loved the sheep and ducks.

lines.beaver_en: What did you see in the garden?
lines.en: Roses were blooming in the garden.

lines.beaver_en: The forsythia over there bloomed nicely too.
lines.learner: 네, 노란 개나리 밑에 풀도 많이 나 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, there's a lot of grass under the yellow forsythia.
lines.roman: Ne, noran gaenari mite puldo mani na isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: By the way, you have lots of flowerpots at home.
lines.learner: 네, 화분을 가꾸는 게 제 취미예요.
lines.en: Yes, tending flowerpots is my hobby.
lines.roman: Ne, hwabuneul gakkuneun ge je chwimiyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Isn't it hard to take care of plants?
lines.en: Sometimes the roots rot and leaves fall off.

lines.learner: 아직 없어요. 지난주엔 화분 옆에 쥐가 숨어 있었어요.
lines.en: Not yet. Last week a mouse was hiding by a pot.
lines.roman: Ajik eopseoyo. Jinanjuen hwabun yeope jwiga sumeo isseosseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그런데 우리 정원에 사과 따러 갈래요?
lines.beaver_en: By the way, want to go pick apples in our garden?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureonde uri jeongwone sagwa ttareo gallaeyo?
lines.learner: 좋아요. 사과를 따서 같이 먹어요. 가요!
lines.en: Sure. Let's pick apples and eat them together. Let's go!
lines.roman: Joayo. Sagwareul ttaseo gachi meogeoyo. Gayo!
